name: Acme SDK Docs Squad
description: Answers developer questions about the Acme Python SDK with a version/deprecation check and a runnable code sample for the developer's SDK version. Orchestrates two internal workers (version/deprecation, code-sample); callers see one agent.

skills.name: Answer an SDK question for a specific SDK version
skills.description: Returns {answer, v3_code, deprecations[], sources[]}. Every code sample is backed by a version/deprecation check; if that check cannot run, the task asks for the SDK version (input-required) instead of shipping an unchecked sample.
examples: TooManyRequestsError how to get the retry delay

skills.name: Check whether an SDK symbol changed between v2 and v3
skills.description: Removed / renamed / default-changed status and the v3 replacement for one symbol, from the v3 changelog.
